basic_info.description: Check out this amazing property located in the vibrant neighborhood of San Francisco, the Financial District! Unit 620 at the Bay Crest is a spacious corner property with lots of natural light and amazing views from every room! The unit comes equipped with laundry and all appliances. This property features 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, 1 assigned secured parking space and 24/7 security guard at the lobby. HOA includes BBQ area, fitness room, yoga room, sauna, racquetball court and outdoor heated pool. Close proximity to the freeways, public transportation and Chase and Oracle stadiums.
